known_limitations: Prompt expectation 'A01 -> (3/4)^n' is incorrect: Z/X guess measure-resend gives (5/8)^n (Bayes-optimal resend (0.6545)^n); 3/4 needs a coherent channel (A04/MVW).
Two negative controls are mathematically undetectable on BB84 n=1 (transpose omitted; MVW factor order): run on six-state / n=2 instead (done).
Bit-order/relabeling bugs do not change optimal-attack values; caught only by honest-acceptance checks.
CERTIFIED_NUMERIC = exact-rational check of a dual certificate by our own LDL^T code, not a proof-assistant proof; needs an independent re-check (lane D/M).
Simulation register keeps positions unentangled; joint coherent attacks covered only by SDP (n<=2).
A06/A08 games are toy verifiers defined in qmint/attacks/games.py, not published protocols; MVW eq.(4) is a joint-both-copies event and is NOT a per-note W2 bound.
Clarabel n=2 needs ~6.5 GB RSS and returns optimal_inaccurate on the primal; marked slow in tests.
W1 theorem constant duplicated in qmint/attacks/games.py until lane D theorem registry lands; should then import from lane D.
